correctness.rationale: From the sixteen endpoint sums of four sign generators t_i=(±1,±1,±1), the rhombic dodecahedron equals Σ[-t_i/2,t_i/2]. Thus W(u)=Σ|<diag(a,b,c)t_i,u>|. The spherical first moment of each summand is √S/2 and the second cross moment equals 2SΦ(ρ)/(3π). Pair correlations ρ_a,ρ_b,ρ_c each occur twice, yielding EW=2√S and EW²=4S/3+8S/(3π)ΣΦ(ρ). Since Σρ_i=−1, Φʺ(t)=1/√(1−t²)≥1 gives unique Jensen minimizer ρ_i=−1/3 and the stated stability coefficient via strong convexity. Since Φ(t)<π/2 for −1<t<1, Var(W)<4S/3 with equality approached only as axes degenerate. Independent exact numerical evaluation for a=b=c, (1,2,3), (.1,.1,1) matched the closed regular value 0.067918113012 and had positive stability residuals; program verifies vertex support and Monte Carlo but not infinite quantifiers.
